node.label: Abnormal central sensory function
node.definition: An abnormality of sensation related to CNS function. Assuming the primary sensory modalities are intact and the patient is alert and cooperative, the presence of an abnormality of sensory function may indicate a lesion of a parietal cortex, the thalamocortical projections to the parietal cortex, or the spinal cord.

evidence.snippet: Gerstmann-Straussler-Scheinker syndrome: Abnormal central sensory function (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
